title: The HTML DOM
text:
The HTML DOM



HTML Document Object Model

The
HTML DOM
(HTML Document Object Model) is an
Object Model for HTML Documents
.

The
HTML DOM
is a tree of
Nodes
that represents an
HTML Page
.

The DOM Tree

When a web page loads, the browser creates a tree-like representation of the HTML document.

Each part of the document are nodes in the tree:

The World Wide Web Consortium

The DOM is a
W3C Standard
(World Wide Web Consortium):

"The W3C Document Object Model (DOM) is a platform and language-neutral
interface that allows programs and scripts to dynamically access and update the
content, structure, and style of a document."

The W3C DOM standard is separated into 3 different parts:

Core DOM - standard model for all document types

XML DOM - standard model for XML documents

HTML DOM - standard model for HTML documents

The
HTML DOM
is a language independent standard developed by the W3C and WHATWG.
